name: Borgo Pignano
positioning: Countryside estate near Volterra in Tuscany, with outdoor and hands-on experiences such as truffle hunting, horse riding and an apiary tour
best_for: Travelers who want an active countryside stay in Tuscany
Guests interested in hands-on experiences like cooking, painting and artisanal workshops

facts.text: Borgo Pignano's countryside property is in the Volterra area of Tuscany; the brand also has a separate property in Florence.
A tour of the estate is offered at the Volterra property.
Horse riding is offered at the Volterra property.
Forest bathing is offered at the Volterra property.
A foraging walk is offered at the Volterra property.
Walks and bike outings are offered at the Volterra property.
Yoga classes are offered at the Volterra property.
Painting classes and artisanal workshops are offered at the Volterra property.
A visit to the town of Volterra is offered as one of the property's experiences.
Wine tasting and cooking classes are offered at the Volterra property.

highlights.text: Truffle hunting is offered at the Volterra property.
An apiary tour is offered at the Volterra property.
Guests can explore the land through forest bathing, a foraging walk and horse riding.

considerations.text: Borgo Pignano has two properties, one near Volterra and one in Florence; experiences differ by location, so confirm which property is booked.
WhataHotel notes the remote countryside location means a rental car is needed to explore the area.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury estate positioning.
